title: Which reruns owe you the same bits?
heading: cuOpt's MILP Did Not Repeat, Even in Its Determinism Mode
cases: a rerun of one configuration that repeats is held to its bits
runs on different devices are compared within the tolerance, and other inputs are not compared
a concurrent run is not held to its bits
a cuOpt MILP run is not held to its bits
a different thread count is another configuration
the tolerance is relative to the objective
